note: Machine-readable operator handoff. Contains only presence flags, env-var NAMES, commands and dashboard steps — no secret values of any kind. The evidence generator is the source of truth: re-run node scripts/phase-w-evidence.mjs after provisioning to re-evaluate the gates.

items.service: Supabase (hosted project: Auth + PostgREST + PostgreSQL + Storage + backups)
items.purpose: Real database/auth/RLS/storage/backup for the pilot (W2–W6, W17)
items.free_or_paid: Free tier (2 free projects) — paid Pro ~$25/mo only if needed (Rule 3 approval)
items.estimated_cost: $0 free; Pro ~$25/mo only with user approval
items.dashboard_action: Create org + project at supabase.com/dashboard; Settings → API for URL/keys; service_role key stays server-side
items.secret_storage_location: .env.local / deployment secret store / CI secret store — never in git, evidence or chat
items.verification_command: curl -sI https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/health  # expect HTTP 200; then node scripts/phase-w-evidence.mjs

items.service: Malware scanner (ClamAV via clamav-rest, or supported webhook)

items.secret_storage_location: .env.local / deployment secret store — never in git, evidence or chat
items.verification_command: clean file → accepted; EICAR → rejected; scanner stopped → upload rejected (fail closed); then node scripts/phase-w-evidence.mjs
